prompt: What makes Court Three unsuitable for the woman’s original plans?
promptZh: 三號球場為何不適合女方原先的安排？

options.text: It is also closed for repainting.
options.zh: 那裡也因重畫球場線而關閉。
options.whyZh: 關閉的是二號，三號五點有空。

options.text: It is available only for practice against a wall.
options.zh: 三號球場只能對牆練球。
options.whyZh: 練習牆是另一種選擇，不等於三號球場。

options.text: It becomes available too late for her partner.
options.zh: 球場有空時，搭檔已不能再留。
options.whyZh: 三號五點才有空，但搭檔最晚五點就得離開。

options.text: She has already booked a different court at five.
options.zh: 她已訂了五點的另一個球場。
options.whyZh: 她原先訂的是四點的二號。

explanationZh: 三號五點才有空，但搭檔最晚五點就得離開。
evidence: No. The crew repainted the lines today. The court stays closed until they remove the barrier, even though the net is back up. Court Three is free at five, or you can use the practice wall from four. / My doubles partner has to leave by five. Can I keep the original booking and hit balls against the wall now?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: No. The crew repainted the lines today. The court stays closed until they remove the barrier, even though the net is back up. Court Three is free at five, or you can use the practice wall from four.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: My doubles partner has to leave by five. Can I keep the original booking and hit balls against the wall now?

vocabulary.note: by five 表示最晚不得超過五點。
